subject.title: 34 built-in skills missing trigger phrases in description field

question: Should bundled skill frontmatter descriptions be expanded with concise trigger/WHEN wording now, or should this cleanup wait for a structured trigger metadata contract?
rationale: Current source still uses `description` as the prompt selection signal, but repository docs also prefer short descriptions and an open issue proposes an explicit trigger field; automation should not choose that public skill-authoring policy.

options.title: Approve concise description cleanup
options.body: Allow one narrow metadata-only update that keeps descriptions short and trigger-critical, then repair or replace the partial open PR as needed.

options.title: Defer to structured triggers
options.body: Leave descriptions compact and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76782 the owner for explicit trigger semantics.

options.title: Decline trigger expansion
options.body: Document that current concise descriptions are intentional and close the related partial PRs/issues as not planned.

recommendation.title: Approve concise description cleanup
recommendation.body: Allow one narrow metadata-only update that keeps descriptions short and trigger-critical, then repair or replace the partial open PR as needed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent skill guidance and description-policy history makes this the strongest routing candidate for the policy choice.
